0022600094.text: The Charlotte Hornets host the Atlanta Hawks in Charlotte's second game of the season, with both teams at 1-0. The Hornets, who won their opener on the road, are 3rd in the Southeast and 6th in the East, while the Hawks are 1st in the Southeast and 3rd in the East. Charlotte is without Coby White (calf strain), Grant Williams (hamstring), Kon Knueppel (hamstring), and Kylan Boswell (knee, surgery), and Atlanta is without Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and Charlotte won the 2025-26 season series 3-1, including a 110-107 win over Atlanta in Charlotte on February 11, 2026.
